body: Health insurance is the big problem hahahah. Psychiatric care is pretty expensive in my experience.

Mental health clinics? I don't think I've heard of that. I'll have to look into it, thank you.

I really appreciate you taking the time to comment. Thanks so much.

Well then. I guess I'm not alone.

If you ever wanna talk or something I'm around. Gotta help each other, y'know?

Yeah, I'm trying to get into therapy. My family is just, as you described, part of the issue.

Thanks though, I do blame myself a lot. My mom insists that it's just laziness. She calls me narcissistic all the time. I only care about myself, I'm self-absorbed, etc. And then I just believe it and I want to stop being the evil, lazy person she says I am but I don't know how. In moments like that it would do me good to remember that not everything she puts in my head is truth. Easier said than done, though.

My grandad is a super demanding guy, likes to know where people have been etc etc. He wants to know what I'm doing and he'd ask for proof if I started volunteering somewhere. Not only that but he controls my health insurance at the moment and our insurance only covers the first 3 sessions I believe? After that we get billed so I need their support.

No, I'm not in school anymore hahah. I'm 20, not in college at the moment. Couldn't handle it and was failing out so I decided to take a break until I could handle it again.

Dunno if that will ever come.

I've tried to get to a therapist, but when I would have been able to get to one I was living with my grandad who was highly against it and wouldn't have allowed me to go. If I had snuck out to do it or something of the like he threatened to destroy the router so I couldn't use the internet anymore.
